summary: Uranium Royalty Corp. (URC) filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval of a plan of arrangement under which the Sweetwater Investors (Orion Resource Partners affiliates and Ontario Teachers Pension Plan) will contribute/sell their ~92% interest in trona royalty assets and Wyoming/Utah/Colorado landholdings to New URC, a newly formed Delaware parent. Shareholders voted 99.43% in favor. The arrangement is expected to close on or about July 27, 2026, with New URC common stock listing on Nasdaq on July 28, 2026. The filing also notes CFO Andy Marshall will step down post-closing. Completion is subject to a final court order and customary conditions. Watch for court approval and any regulatory delays before close.
